language.description: (Deprecated: use codeReference.language instead.) Programming language of the lens implementation (e.g., 'python', 'typescript')

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this lens was created

getterCode.description: Code reference for getter function (Source -> Target)

putterCode.description: Code reference for putter function (Target, Source -> Source)

sourceSchemaVersion.description: Semver version or range for source schema compatibility (e.g., '1.0.0', '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0')

targetSchemaVersion.description: Semver version or range for target schema compatibility (e.g., '1.0.0', '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0')

main.description: Bidirectional transformation (Lens) between two sample types, with code stored in external repositories

lensMetadata.description: Open metadata object for lens records. Applications may extend with additional fields (author, performance notes, etc.).

branch.description: Optional branch name (for reference, commit hash is authoritative)

language.description: Programming language of the code at this reference. Prefer this over the top-level language field for per-function granularity.

codeReference.description: Reference to code in an external repository (GitHub, tangled.org, etc.)
